- India: 3,167–3,682
- Russia: 573–600
- Indonesia: 393

- Thailand: 148–189

- **Total: 5,638–5,899**

The table's own wording is "Global wild tiger population … Total 5,638–5,899".

The section's prose then moves on to legal protection and national conservation efforts. I didn't see another global population figure in the part of the section I read. My read of the section was cut off partway through the paragraph on wildlife corridors, so I did not see the rest of it.
